Title: Validate measurement and establish baseline
Scope: Reconcile Shopify completed online-store orders; audit March-April ATC duplication; segment by device and channel.
Acceptance criteria: Signed-off event QA and baseline dashboard; historical anomalies annotated.

Title: Prioritize hypotheses and define test plans
Scope: Rank shipping transparency, cart friction, email and acquisition opportunities; define eligibility, randomization, MDE and stopping rules.
Acceptance criteria: Approved backlog and experiment briefs; primary metric RPV with conversion, margin, AOV and performance guardrails.

Title: Design cart cost transparency and checkout improvements
Scope: Design shipping and tax estimates, delivery reassurance and express-payment hierarchy; assess form and opt-in changes within Shopify plan constraints.
Acceptance criteria: Approved desktop/mobile designs; accurate estimates, policy copy and technical feasibility.

Title: Develop and QA cart and checkout experiment
Scope: Implement candidate changes in staging; verify regional estimates, checkout tracking, browser/device coverage, accessibility and rollback.
Acceptance criteria: QA sign-off, no duplicate events and documented rollback before exposure.

Title: Evaluate cost-transparency experiment
Scope: Run a controlled experiment if traffic supports the agreed sample; monitor checkout completion, RPV and contribution margin.
Acceptance criteria: Decision memo with confidence intervals and guardrails; extend or retain control if inconclusive.

Title: Build cart reassurance and accessory concepts
Scope: Prototype free-shipping threshold/progress, theme-matched accessories, collapsed notes and mobile checkout CTA.
Acceptance criteria: Margin-approved threshold and prototype QA; test separately from MF05 unless mutually exclusive.

Title: Develop Remarkety lifecycle flows
Scope: Design browse abandonment, post-purchase cross-sell, VIP access and 60/90/120-day win-back triggers.
Acceptance criteria: Consent, suppression, product feeds and deliverability verified; holdouts defined. Long win-back outcomes may extend beyond October.

Title: Validate Meta and search acquisition strategy
Scope: Review attribution, campaign intent and new/returning cohorts; test controlled retargeting and search allocations after signal QA.
Acceptance criteria: Budget decision based on incrementality, CAC and contribution margin; no automatic switch based only on channel averages.

Title: Test cart merchandising and mobile checkout CTA
Scope: Test the next highest-priority cart hypothesis sequentially; confirm any shipping incentive preserves margin.
Acceptance criteria: Experiment readout; implementation conditional on sample sufficiency and guardrails.

Title: Pilot lifecycle flows and measure incrementality
Scope: Stage eligible flow launches; monitor holdouts, revenue per recipient, unsubscribes and complaints.
Acceptance criteria: Flow-level decision log; separate observed early results from immature 60/90/120-day cohorts.

Title: Assess BNPL and search expansion feasibility
Scope: Assess provider fees, payment eligibility, checkout compatibility and search expansion economics.
Acceptance criteria: Go/no-go business case; pilot only after commercial and technical approval.

Title: Roll out validated changes and deliver handover
Scope: Release only validated changes with monitoring; compile experiment decisions, unresolved hypotheses, playbook and next-quarter backlog.
Acceptance criteria: Documented release/rollback checklist and stakeholder readout; no assumed uplift or completion claims.
